about: What the McTrot 5 recorder recorded, as export-archive.ts reads it: from recorder-redacted-2026-11-21.sqlite (the event database with private details removed), dumped 2026-11-23 so the database itself isn't needed. points: [ts, lat, lon, accuracy m] (no battery, speed or receive times). visitTaps: check-in tap times. posts: ready, not hidden. weather: each reading, with only the cloud and visibility fields of Open-Meteo's reply the sky needs (current). guestComments: approved only, with the display name and link each guest chose (no emails or accounts). guestLikes: times only. All times are ms since epoch.

posts.text: Approaching midtown. Time to lock in
Macy’s is closed until 10, despite the McDs website saying the McDs inside should be open. A conundrum. I think I’m allowed to skip
Canal St still closed for remodel. They were supposed to be done yesterday
Restaurants are starting go get busy with lunch
